title: Travel: John Lennon – Tokyo to Frankfurt | 1977
content:
John Lennon travelled from Tokyo to Frankfurt in Germany on 7 October 1977.

John and Sean had arrived in Hong Kong from New York on 6 May, and flew to Tokyo on 11 May. With them on the trip were their personal assistant Nishi Saimaru and Sean’s nanny Masako, and they were joined by broadcaster Elliott Mintz in August.

Lennon and Mintz flew back together. They flew from Tokyo to Hong Kong, then to Dubai, and stayed overnight in Frankfurt. They flew from Germany to New York on 8 October.
